column3: Close to the Hebrew; טֹפְלֵי־ (“plasterers”) is rendered “forgers.”
Close to the Hebrew; “will you lift up his face” is rendered “Will you show partiality for Him?”
Close to the Hebrew; זִכְרֹנֵיכֶם (“your maxims”) is rendered “Your platitudes.”
NKJV follows the traditional reading “to him,” giving “Though He slay me, yet will I trust Him”; the written text reads “not,” i.e., “I have no hope.”
Close to the Hebrew; חָנֵף (“a godless person”) is rendered “a hypocrite.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I am in the right” is rendered “I shall be vindicated.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you mark the roots of my feet” is rendered “You set a limit for the soles of my feet.”
Close to the Hebrew; the pronoun “he” is made explicit as “Man.”
